text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leave the academy on Valentine's Day to find Bamboo Memory waiting outside covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: These chocolates are to show you my appreciation for all your hard work every day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to focus on the chocolates, but Bamboo Memory seems to notice me stealing glances at her muddied clothes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, actually, getting these to you was quite the ordeal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew… I've finally made it. The Hidden Gem certainly lives up to its name!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But people say their chocolates are so delicious, they'll bring a tear to your eye—chocolates everyone should try at least once in their life!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If the rumors are true, then… hehe! I sure can't wait to see the look on Trainer's face!

text_block_list.name: Boar
text_block_list.text: Snort, snort… Grumble!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A boar?! Yikes! What's a boar doing h—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait! Are you trying to take my chocolates?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't pull on them! Give them back! Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Graaahhh! There's no WAY I'm letting you have these chocolates! Shoo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ack, now the packaging is all messed up! I'm gonna have to rewrap them…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Ooh, ooh, ooh! Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now there's a monkey?! These chocolates even entices animals… They really do live up to the hype!

text_block_list.name: Boar
text_block_list.text: Snort! Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You again?! Ugh! You don't give up, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …I've chased around plenty of rule breakers before, but I'm not used to being on the other side of the chase.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Looks like I've gotta handle this head-on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, Trainerrrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I managed to get them here!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um, would you mind trying them right away?! I've been looking forward to seeing your reaction more than anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears these are limited-edition chocolates from a shop called The Hidden Gem. I open the package to reveal what waits inside…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooh! So these are Hidden Gem chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh… They look kind of… messy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The chocolates inside the box look as though they've melted.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! I really did it this time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was holding them so tight, they must've melted from my body heat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! This is not at all how I envisioned this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Really? But they're so… gloopy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't mind a little melted chocolate. Plus, she faced all kinds of danger to get these to me, so I'm definitely going to enjoy them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You'll really eat them? Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pick out a piece of chocolate barely holding its shape and pop it in my mouth… which is soon enveloped in sweetness! The rich scent of cacao fills my nostrils!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But it's so messy… Ooh, you're too kind! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But as you can see… my appreciation for you burns bright!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: In fact, it's so intense that it melts chocolate! Hehe! Careful you don't burn yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems I got more than just chocolate this Valentine's Day… I also got a taste of Bamboo Memory's appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I'll fix them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way! They need to be proper chocolates if they're going to show my appreciation properly!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! I've got this! I just need to put the chocolate in a mold and let it harden!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: First, I have to melt it some more! Let's get this bowl in some hot water!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gotta make some delicious chocolate! Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Hm, not quite! I've gotta make them even more delicious! Have some of this! And this! Aaaand this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Agh! Now there's chocolate EVERYWHERE!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There's only enough left for one piece! How could this have happened?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't express my gratitude with just this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I just keep messing it up…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But… no! I'm not giving up! Even if I can only make one small piece of chocolate…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm still going to do it right and fill it with all of my feelings!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to try it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Great! No matter how many tries it takes, I promise I'll finish it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! It really is just one piece. Sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It may be just one piece, but it has a sense of warmth and weight to it, almost as if it's packed with warm feelings.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: H-hey, don't just stare at it like that! Hurry up and eat it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, but first… Happy Valentine's Day! Again! …Hehe!
